author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE.

Independent verification:
- cargo build --workspace: clean.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: clean (exit 0).
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --no-run --tests: 3 binaries compiled (lib, main, db_smoke).
- Forbidden-pattern grep across polaris-backend/src/: zero unwrap()/expect( hits; zero string-built SQL; zero Arc<PgPool> wrapping (only a doc comment explaining why NOT to wrap); zero anyhow in non-main src (only doc comments documenting the policy); zero crate-root #![allow]; zero unsafe.
- db/mod.rs rustdoc captures design invariants; DbError preserves cause chain via #[source]; Db::ping uses explicit drop(conn) over let _ for documented intent.

Dispatch deviated honestly from pre-flight on dep versions (testcontainers 0.27 / testcontainers-modules 0.15 instead of pre-flight's stale 0.23 / 0.11), with crates.io verification recorded.

Two YAGNI surfaces left as forward-compat for #13 (ConfigError::InvalidInt variant, Db::pool() accessor) — both reachable from #13's repository work; cost of preemptive trim > cost of leaving.

db_smoke not executed against live Postgres (Docker not assumed in this env); binary compiles, self-skips when Docker absent. #13 exercises the path under a real DB.
